blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS— Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian likened the government’s unified approach to combating poverty to the unity forged by the crafters of the Malolos Constitution as he led the celebration of the 128th anniversary of the Malolos Congress that was held at the historic Barasoain Church here. Gatchalian said Filipino leaders from different regions and provinces in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao gathered at the Barasoain Church on Sept. 15, 1898, to draft the laws of the land, which continue to guide the principles enforced by their modern counterparts under the second Marcos administration.
